# Extra RabbitMQ settings in rabbitmq.conf format. AMP regenerates 00-amp.conf on every start, but never touches this file.
# Files in this folder load in name order, so settings here override the AMP ones.
# See https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/configure#config-file

#!/bin/bash
# Generated by AMP. Starts RabbitMQ and passes each console line to rabbitmqctl (for example: status, list_queues, stop).
cd "$(dirname "$0")" || exit 1
[ -s nodename.txt ] || echo "rabbit-$(od -An -N4 -tx1 /dev/urandom | tr -d ' \n')@localhost" > nodename.txt
export RABBITMQ_NODENAME="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < nodename.txt)"
server/sbin/rabbitmq-server </dev/null &
pid=$!
trap 'server/sbin/rabbitmqctl stop </dev/null; wait "$pid"' TERM INT
while kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; do
    if read -r -t 1 -a args; then
        [ "${#args[@]}" -gt 0 ] && server/sbin/rabbitmqctl "${args[@]}" </dev/null
    elif [ $? -le 128 ]; then
        sleep 1
    fi
done
wait "$pid"
